def create_beta_telegram_composition(
    *,
    user_repository: Any,
    token_repository: Any,
    binding_repository: Any,
    conversation_event_repository: Any,
    privacy_identifier_service: Any,
    conversation_event_validator: Any,
    expiration_minutes: int = 1440,
    conversation_runtime: ConversationRuntime | None = None,
    conversation_runtime_factory: Callable[[], ConversationRuntime] | None = None,
    rate_limiter: Any | None = None,
    abuse_protector: Any | None = None,
    observability: Any | None = None,
    provider_usage_capture: ProviderUsageCapture | None = None,
    provider_usage_repository: ProviderUsageRepository | None = None,
) -> BetaTelegramComposition:
    if expiration_minutes <= 0:
        raise ValueError("expiration_minutes must be greater than zero.")

    if conversation_runtime is not None and conversation_runtime_factory is not None:
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide either conversation_runtime or conversation_runtime_factory, not both."
        )

    beta_access_service = BetaAccessService(
        user_repository=user_repository,
        token_repository=token_repository,
        binding_repository=binding_repository,
        expiration_minutes=expiration_minutes,
    )

    resolved_usage_repository = provider_usage_repository
    if conversation_runtime is not None:
        resolved_conversation_runtime = conversation_runtime
    elif conversation_runtime_factory is not None:
        resolved_conversation_runtime = conversation_runtime_factory()

        # P1.6.1: when production supplies a durable usage repository,
        # attach usage capture to the factory-created ConversationRuntime.
        # Keep the existing factory API and explicit runtime injection seam.
        if (
            provider_usage_repository is not None
            and provider_usage_capture is None
            and isinstance(resolved_conversation_runtime, ConversationRuntime)
            and resolved_conversation_runtime.usage_capture is None
        ):
            provider_usage_service = ProviderUsageService(
                provider_usage_repository
            )
            provider_usage_capture = ProviderUsageCapture(
                provider_usage_service
            )
            resolved_conversation_runtime = replace(
                resolved_conversation_runtime,
                usage_capture=provider_usage_capture,
                usage_context=ProviderUsageContext(
                    capability="conversation",
                    functionality="chat",
                    agent="conversation_agent",
                ),
            )
    else:
        if provider_usage_capture is None:
            if resolved_usage_repository is None:
                resolved_usage_repository = InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
            provider_usage_service = ProviderUsageService(resolved_usage_repository)
            provider_usage_capture = ProviderUsageCapture(provider_usage_service)

        resolved_conversation_runtime = ConversationRuntime(
            llm_provider=LLMProviderFactory.create(),
            usage_capture=provider_usage_capture,
            usage_context=ProviderUsageContext(
                capability="conversation",
                functionality="chat",
                agent="conversation_agent",
            ),
        )

    conversation_service = TelegramConversationService(
        conversation_runtime=resolved_conversation_runtime,
        conversation_event_repository=conversation_event_repository,
        privacy_identifier_service=privacy_identifier_service,
        conversation_event_validator=conversation_event_validator,
    )

    resolved_rate_limiter = rate_limiter or InMemoryTelegramRateLimiter(
        max_messages=_env_positive_int("TELEGRAM_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_MESSAGES", 100),
        window_seconds=_env_positive_float(
            "TELEGRAM_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS", 86400.0
        ),
    )
    resolved_abuse_protector = abuse_protector or InMemoryTelegramAbuseProtector(
        max_messages=_env_positive_int("TELEGRAM_ABUSE_MAX_MESSAGES", 10),
        window_seconds=_env_positive_float(
            "TELEGRAM_ABUSE_WINDOW_SECONDS", 60.0
        ),
    )
    resolved_observability = observability or LoggingTelegramObservability(
        privacy_identifier_service=privacy_identifier_service,
    )

    conversation_boundary = BetaTelegramConversationBoundary(
        conversation_service=conversation_service,
        beta_access_service=beta_access_service,
        rate_limiter=resolved_rate_limiter,
        abuse_protector=resolved_abuse_protector,
        observability=resolved_observability,
    )
    private_chat_gate = BetaPrivateChatGate(beta_access_service=beta_access_service)
    start_handler = BetaTelegramStartHandler(beta_access_service=beta_access_service)
    adapter = BetaTelegramAdapter(
        start_handler=start_handler,
        private_chat_gate=private_chat_gate,
        conversation_boundary=conversation_boundary,
    )
    runtime = TelegramBotRuntime(
        adapter=adapter,
        conversation_boundary=conversation_boundary,
    )

    return BetaTelegramComposition(
        beta_access_service=beta_access_service,
        conversation_runtime=resolved_conversation_runtime,
        conversation_service=conversation_service,
        conversation_boundary=conversation_boundary,
        private_chat_gate=private_chat_gate,
        start_handler=start_handler,
        adapter=adapter,
        runtime=runtime,
        rate_limiter=resolved_rate_limiter,
        abuse_protector=resolved_abuse_protector,
        observability=resolved_observability,
        provider_usage_repository=resolved_usage_repository,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.ai_runtime.conversation.conversation_runtime import (
    ConversationRuntime,
)
from app.application.composition.beta_telegram_composition import (
    BetaTelegramComposition,
    create_beta_telegram_composition,
)
from app.application.conversation_quality.conversation_event_validator import (
    ConversationEventValidator,
)
from app.application.privacy.privacy_identifier_service import (
    PrivacyIdentifierService,
)
from app.application.provider_management.functionality_operational_control_service import (
    FunctionalityOperationalControlService,
)
from app.infrastructure.persistence.database import (
    create_database_engine,
    create_session_factory,
)
from app.infrastructure.persistence.postgresql_beta_access_repository import (
    PostgreSQLBetaTokenRepository,
    PostgreSQLBetaUserRepository,
    PostgreSQLTelegramBindingRepository,

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BetaTelegramProductionComposition:
    beta_telegram: BetaTelegramComposition
    database_engine: Any
    session_factory: Any
    catalogue_service: LearningWorldCatalogueService

    @property
    def runtime(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.runtime

    @property
    def adapter(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.adapter

    @property
    def beta_access_service(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.beta_access_service

    @property
    def conversation_runtime(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.conversation_runtime

    @property
    def conversation_service(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.conversation_service

    @property
    def conversation_boundary(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.conversation_boundary

    @property
    def private_chat_gate(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.private_chat_gate

    @property
    def start_handler(self) -> Any:
        return self.beta_telegram.start_handler


def create_production_beta_telegram_composition(
    *,
    expiration_minutes: int = 1440,
    database_engine: Any | None = None,
    session_factory: Any | None = None,
    database_engine_factory: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
    session_factory_factory: Callable[[Any], Any] | None = None,
    conversation_runtime: ConversationRuntime | None = None,
    conversation_runtime_factory: Callable[[], ConversationRuntime] | None = None,
    functionality_control_service: (
        FunctionalityOperationalControlService | None
    ) = None,
    language_detector: LanguageDetector | None = None,
) -> BetaTelegramProductionComposition:
    """Create the production Beta Telegram composition.

    Production Telegram processing requires the operational
    functionality-control service. The service is injected from
    the application composition; this factory never creates a
    second control service or control repository.
    """

    if expiration_minutes <= 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "expiration_minutes must be greater than zero."
        )

    if functionality_control_service is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "functionality_control_service is required "
            "for production Telegram composition."
        )

    if language_detector is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "language_detector is required "
            "for production Telegram composition."
        )

    if (
        database_engine is not None
        and database_engine_factory is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide either database_engine or "
            "database_engine_factory, not both."
        )

    if (
        session_factory is not None
        and session_factory_factory is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide either session_factory or "
            "session_factory_factory, not both."
        )

    if (
        conversation_runtime is not None
        and conversation_runtime_factory is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide either conversation_runtime or "
            "conversation_runtime_factory, not both."
        )

    if database_engine is None:
        database_engine = (
            database_engine_factory
            or create_database_engine
        )()

    if session_factory is None:
        session_factory = (
            session_factory_factory
            or create_session_factory
        )(database_engine)

    beta_user_repository = PostgreSQLBetaUserRepository(
        session_factory,
    )
    beta_token_repository = PostgreSQLBetaTokenRepository(
        session_factory,
    )
    telegram_binding_repository = (
        PostgreSQLTelegramBindingRepository(
            session_factory,
        )
    )
    conversation_event_repository = (
        PostgreSQLConversationEventRepository(
            session_factory,
        )
    )

    # Durable provider usage ledger.
    # Accounting remains outside the Operations Center.
    provider_usage_repository = (
        PostgreSQLProviderUsageRepository(
            session_factory,
        )
    )

    privacy_identifier_service = PrivacyIdentifierService()
    conversation_event_validator = (
        ConversationEventValidator()
    )

    # One authoritative WorldResolver is shared by Beta access and
    # Learning World catalogue resolution.
    app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    world_repository = YamlWorldRepository(
        worlds_path=app_root / "configuration" / "worlds"
    )
    world_resolver = WorldResolver(
        world_repository=world_repository,
    )

    catalogue_repository = PostgreSQLLearningWorldCatalogueRepository(
        session_factory
    )
    catalogue_service = LearningWorldCatalogueService(
        repository=catalogue_repository,
        world_resolver=world_resolver,
    )

    beta_telegram = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=beta_user_repository,
        token_repository=beta_token_repository,
        binding_repository=telegram_binding_repository,
        conversation_event_repository=(
            conversation_event_repository
        ),
        privacy_identifier_service=(
            privacy_identifier_service
        ),
        conversation_event_validator=(
            conversation_event_validator
        ),
        expiration_minutes=expiration_minutes,
        conversation_runtime=conversation_runtime,
        conversation_runtime_factory=(
            conversation_runtime_factory
        ),
        provider_usage_repository=(
            provider_usage_repository
        ),
        functionality_control_service=(
            functionality_control_service
        ),
        world_resolver=world_resolver,
        language_response_policy=LanguageResponsePolicy(),
        language_detector=language_detector,
    )

    logger.info(
        "Production Beta Telegram composition created "
        "with durable usage ledger and functionality control."
    )

    return BetaTelegramProductionComposition(
        beta_telegram=beta_telegram,
        database_engine=database_engine,
        session_factory=session_factory,
        catalogue_service=catalogue_service,
    )


__all__ = [
    "BetaTelegramProductionComposition",
    "create_production_beta_telegram_composition",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from app.ai_runtime.conversation.conversation_runtime import (
    ConversationRuntime,
)
from app.providers.llm.llm_provider_factory import (
    LLMProviderFactory,
)


def create_conversation_runtime() -> ConversationRuntime:
    """
    Create shared ConversationRuntime.

    Composition layer responsibility.

    Channels:
    - Telegram
    - Voice
    - Future channels

    This function does not:
    - execute conversations
    - store memory
    - manage transport
    """

    return ConversationRuntime(
        llm_provider=(
            LLMProviderFactory.create()
        )
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ConversationEvent:
    """
    Domain model for conversation events.

    Privacy model:

    Stores:
        - pseudonymous learner identity
        - conversation session
        - learning context
        - message content

    Does NOT store:
        - Telegram ID
        - email
        - direct identity


    Future consumers:

        Conversation Events
              |
              v
        Memory Engine
              |
              v
        Learning Intelligence
    """

    event_id: str

    conversation_id: str

    telegram_user_hash: str

    world_id: str

    channel: str

    role: str

    content: str

    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None

    created_at: datetime

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

from .conversation_event_models import (
    ConversationEvent,
)


class ConversationEventRepository(ABC):
    """
    Repository contract for conversation event storage.

    Privacy/isolation model:

        telegram_user_hash
                +
        conversation_id
                +
            world_id

    Implementations:

        PostgreSQL
        Future:
        - event streams
        - analytics storage
        - data lake
    """

    @abstractmethod
    async def save(
        self,
        event: ConversationEvent,
    ) -> ConversationEvent:
        """
        Persist one conversation event.
        """
        ...

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_recent(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_hash: str,
        conversation_id: str,
        world_id: str,
        limit: int = 20,
    ) -> list[ConversationEvent]:
        """
        Retrieve recent events for one isolated conversation.

        Isolation key:

            telegram_user_hash
                    +
            conversation_id
                    +
                world_id

        No direct Telegram identity is used.
        """
        ...

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class ConversationEventValidator:
    """
    Validates conversation events before persistence.

    Governance controls:

    - no raw identity
    - no injected learner context
    - metadata completeness
    - retention classification

    Used before:
    
        ConversationEventRepository.save()

    """

    REQUIRED_METADATA = {
        "world_id",
        "character",
        "level",
        "source",
        "retention_policy_id",
    }


    FORBIDDEN_CONTENT = {
        "email:",
        "user:",
        "telegram_user_id",
        "beta learner context",
        "david@example.com",
    }


    def validate(
        self,
        *,
        content: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None,
        telegram_user_hash: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

        if not telegram_user_hash:
            raise ValueError(
                "Conversation event requires pseudonymous identity."
            )


        if not content:
            raise ValueError(
                "Conversation content cannot be empty."
            )


        lowered = content.lower()


        for item in self.FORBIDDEN_CONTENT:

            if item.lower() in lowered:

                raise ValueError(
                    f"Forbidden personal context detected: {item}"
                )


        if metadata is None:

            raise ValueError(
                "Conversation metadata missing."
            )


        missing = (
            self.REQUIRED_METADATA
            -
            metadata.keys()
        )


        if missing:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing metadata: {missing}"
            )


        return {
            "valid": True,
            "checks": {
                "identity_protection": True,
                "metadata_complete": True,
                "retention_classified": True,
            },
        }

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from typing import Any

from app.application.memory.memory_candidate import (
    MemoryCandidate,
)

from app.application.memory.memory_policy import (
    MemoryPolicy,
)


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MemoryApprovalService:
    """
    Memory governance approval service.

    Responsibilities:

    - validate memory candidates
    - approve educational memories
    - reject unsuitable memories
    - create governance decisions

    Does NOT:

    - persist memory
    - call AI providers
    - modify learner profiles
    - bypass privacy controls

    Beta 1.5.4 boundary:

        MemoryCandidate
              |
              v
        MemoryApprovalService
              |
              v
        MemoryPolicy
              |
              v
        Governance Decision

    Future:

        Approved Candidate
              |
              v
        Domain MemoryItem
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        memory_policy: MemoryPolicy,
    ) -> None:

        if memory_policy is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "memory_policy cannot be None."
            )

        self._policy = memory_policy

    def approve(
        self,
        candidate: MemoryCandidate,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Approve a memory candidate.

        Current Beta behaviour:

        - validates the candidate
        - returns a governance decision
        - does NOT persist memory

        The response intentionally contains both:

        Current Beta fields:
            category
            observation

        Future domain-aligned fields:
            memory_type
            content
        """

        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "candidate cannot be None."
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Normalize candidate fields
        # -------------------------------------------------

        memory_type = (
            candidate.memory_type
            or candidate.category
        )

        content = (
            candidate.content
            or candidate.observation
        )

        learner_id = (
            candidate.learner_id
            or candidate.learner_hash
        )

        confidence_score = (
            candidate.confidence_score
            if candidate.confidence_score is not None
            else candidate.confidence
        )

        source_event_id = (
            candidate.source_event_id
        )

        if (
            source_event_id is None
            and candidate.evidence_event_ids
        ):
            source_event_id = (
                candidate.evidence_event_ids[0]
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Policy validation
        # -------------------------------------------------

        self._policy.validate(
            memory_type=memory_type,
            content=content,
        )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Governance decision
        # -------------------------------------------------

        decision = {
            "status": "approved",

            "candidate_id": (
                candidate.candidate_id
            ),

            # Current Beta contract
            "category": (
                candidate.category
                or memory_type
            ),

            "observation": (
                candidate.observation
                or content
            ),

            # Future domain-aligned contract
            "memory_type": memory_type,

            "content": content,

            "learner_id": learner_id,

            "confidence_score": confidence_score,

            "source_event_id": source_event_id,

            "evidence_event_ids": (
                candidate.evidence_event_ids
                or (
                    [source_event_id]
                    if source_event_id
                    else []
                )
            ),

            "metadata": {
                **(
                    candidate.metadata
                    or {}
                ),
                "approval_status": "approved",
            },
        }

        logger.info(
            "Memory candidate approved id=%s",
            candidate.candidate_id,
        )

        return decision

    def reject(
        self,
        candidate: MemoryCandidate,
        *,
        reason: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Reject a memory candidate.

        Rejection does not:

        - persist memory
        - modify learner data
        - create a MemoryItem

        A governance decision is returned instead.
        """

        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "candidate cannot be None."
            )

        if not reason or not reason.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "Rejection reason required."
            )

        memory_type = (
            candidate.memory_type
            or candidate.category
        )

        learner_id = (
            candidate.learner_id
            or candidate.learner_hash
        )

        source_event_id = (
            candidate.source_event_id
        )

        if (
            source_event_id is None
            and candidate.evidence_event_ids
        ):
            source_event_id = (
                candidate.evidence_event_ids[0]
            )

        decision = {
            "status": "rejected",

            "candidate_id": (
                candidate.candidate_id
            ),

            "learner_id": learner_id,

            # Current Beta contract
            "category": (
                candidate.category
                or memory_type
            ),

            # Future domain-aligned contract
            "memory_type": memory_type,

            "reason": reason.strip(),

            "source_event_id": source_event_id,

            "evidence_event_ids": (
                candidate.evidence_event_ids
                or (
                    [source_event_id]
                    if source_event_id
                    else []
                )
            ),

            "metadata": {
                **(
                    candidate.metadata
                    or {}
                ),
                "approval_status": "rejected",
            },
        }

        logger.info(
            "Memory candidate rejected id=%s",
            candidate.candidate_id,
        )

        return decision

from __future__ import annotations


from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MemoryCandidate:
    """
    Temporary educational memory proposal.

    Compatibility boundary between:

    Beta memory workflow
        +
    Future domain MemoryItem model.


    Not persisted.
    """

    candidate_id: str

    learner_id: str | None = None

    memory_type: str | None = None

    content: str | None = None

    confidence_score: float | None = None

    source_event_id: str | None = None

    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    created_at: datetime | None = None


    # -------------------------------------------------
    # Backward compatibility fields
    # -------------------------------------------------

    learner_hash: str | None = None

    category: str | None = None

    observation: str | None = None

    confidence: float | None = None

    evidence_event_ids: list[str] | None = None



    def normalized_memory_type(self) -> str:
        """
        Returns unified memory type.
        """

        return (
            self.memory_type
            or self.category
            or ""
        )



    def normalized_content(self) -> str:
        """
        Returns unified content.
        """

        return (
            self.content
            or self.observation
            or ""
        )



    def normalized_confidence(self) -> float:
        """
        Returns unified confidence.
        """

        return (
            self.confidence_score
            if self.confidence_score is not None
            else self.confidence
            or 0.0
        )



    def normalized_learner_id(self) -> str:
        """
        Returns learner identifier.

        Future:
        this becomes learner_id only.
        """

        return (
            self.learner_id
            or self.learner_hash
            or ""
        )



    def normalized_source_events(self) -> list[str]:
        """
        Returns evidence events.
        """

        if self.evidence_event_ids:
            return self.evidence_event_ids

        if self.source_event_id:
            return [self.source_event_id]

        return []

from __future__ import annotations


from typing import Final


class MemoryPolicy:
    """
    Governance policy for learner memory.

    Application boundary.

    Responsibilities:

    - educational relevance validation
    - privacy minimisation
    - prevent unnecessary personal data retention

    Does NOT:

    - persist memory
    - approve memory
    - create learner profiles
    """



    ALLOWED_TYPES: Final = {
        "learning_progress",
        "grammar_mistake",
        "grammar_errors",
        "vocabulary",
        "vocabulary_gap",
        "pronunciation",
        "pronunciation_issue",
        "confidence",
        "confidence_level",
        "learning_preference",
        "communication_strength",
    }



    FORBIDDEN_TERMS: Final = {
        "email",
        "phone",
        "password",
        "passport",
        "address",
        "medical",
        "religion",
        "political",
        "financial",
    }



    def validate(
        self,
        *,
        memory_type: str | None = None,
        content: str | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
        observation: str | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Validate memory candidate.

        Supports:

        Current approval flow:

            memory_type
            content


        Legacy:

            category
            observation
        """



        normalized_type = (
            memory_type
            or category
            or ""
        )


        normalized_content = (
            content
            or observation
            or ""
        )



        if not normalized_type:

            raise ValueError(
                "Memory type required."
            )



        if normalized_type not in self.ALLOWED_TYPES:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Memory type not allowed: {normalized_type}"
            )



        lowered = normalized_content.lower()



        for term in self.FORBIDDEN_TERMS:

            if term in lowered:

                raise ValueError(
                    f"Forbidden personal information detected: {term}"
                )



        return True

from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .memory_models import ConversationMemory
from .memory_repository import ConversationMemoryRepository



class MemoryService:
    """
    Application service for learner memory.

    Responsibilities:
    - retrieve learner memories
    - store conversation memories
    - enforce isolation scope

    Does NOT:
    - call LLM
    - manage Telegram
    - manage users
    """


    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repository: ConversationMemoryRepository,
    ) -> None:

        if repository is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "repository cannot be None."
            )

        self._repository = repository



    async def remember(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_id: int,
        world_id: str,
        key: str,
        value: str,
    ) -> ConversationMemory:

        if not value.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "Memory value cannot be empty."
            )


        memory = ConversationMemory(
            memory_id=secrets.token_hex(16),

            telegram_user_id=str(
                telegram_user_id
            ),

            world_id=world_id,

            memory_key=key,

            memory_value=value,

            created_at=datetime.now(
                timezone.utc
            ),
        )


        return await self._repository.save(
            memory
        )



    async def recall(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_id: int,
        world_id: str,
    ) -> list[ConversationMemory]:

        return await self._repository.get_user_memories(
            telegram_user_id=str(
                telegram_user_id
            ),
            world_id=world_id,
        )



    async def clear(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_id: int,
        world_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        await self._repository.clear_user_memory(
            telegram_user_id=str(
                telegram_user_id
            ),
            world_id=world_id,
        )

"""
WS-23.1.4 Telegram publication adapter.

Architecture:

WS-22 AnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter
        â†“
ControlledAnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
TelegramAnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
Existing Telegram client

This adapter:
- does not create a Telegram client;
- does not implement idempotency;
- does not create a repository;
- does not create a database;
- does not bypass the controlled publisher;
- translates the provider-independent WS-22 contract into the
  existing controlled Telegram publication boundary.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from os import getenv
from uuid import UUID

from app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    AnnouncementPublisher,
)


class TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter(AnnouncementPublisher):
    """Bridge the canonical WS-22 publisher contract to Telegram."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        publisher: ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
        channel_id: str | None = None,
        announcement_type: str = "beta_update",
    ) -> None:
        if publisher is None:
            raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

        resolved_channel_id = channel_id or getenv(
            "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID"
        )

        if not resolved_channel_id or not resolved_channel_id.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID is not configured."
            )

        if not announcement_type.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "announcement_type cannot be empty."
            )

        self._publisher = publisher
        self._channel_id = resolved_channel_id.strip()
        self._announcement_type = announcement_type.strip()

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        title: str,
        content: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> str | None:
        """
        Publish through the existing controlled Telegram boundary.

        WS-22 remains responsible for:
        - idempotency;
        - execution persistence;
        - execution audit;
        - retry semantics.

        This adapter only translates the publication request.
        """

        if not isinstance(publication_id, UUID):
            raise ValueError(
                "publication_id must be a UUID."
            )

        if not title.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "title cannot be empty."
            )

        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "content cannot be empty."
            )

        if not correlation_id.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "correlation_id cannot be empty."
            )

        if not idempotency_key.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "idempotency_key cannot be empty."
            )

        text = (
            f"*{title.strip()}*\n\n"
            f"{content.strip()}"
        )

        record = await self._publisher.publish(
            channel_id=self._channel_id,
            text=text,
            announcement_type=self._announcement_type,
        )

        return record.message_id


__all__ = [
    "TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

from app.application.health.health_result import (
    HealthCheckResult,
    HealthStatus,
)


class TelegramHealthCheck:
    """Read-only Telegram Bot API readiness probe.

    Uses Telegram getMe to verify that the configured bot token
    is valid and the Telegram API is reachable.

    No classroom or announcement-group message is sent.
    """

    name = "telegram"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        bot_factory: Any | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._bot_factory = bot_factory

    async def check(self) -> HealthCheckResult:
        token = os.getenv(
            "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
        )

        if not token:
            return HealthCheckResult(
                name=self.name,
                status=HealthStatus.NOT_CONFIGURED,
                details={
                    "configured": False,
                },
            )

        try:
            if self._bot_factory is None:
                from telegram import Bot

                bot = Bot(
                    token=token,
                )
            else:
                bot = self._bot_factory(
                    token,
                )

            try:
                user = await bot.get_me()

            finally:
                shutdown = getattr(
                    bot,
                    "shutdown",
                    None,
                )

                if shutdown is not None:
                    result = shutdown()

                    if hasattr(
                        result,
                        "__await__",
                    ):
                        await result

            return HealthCheckResult(
                name=self.name,
                status=HealthStatus.HEALTHY,
                details={
                    "configured": True,
                    "bot_reachable": True,
                    "bot_id_present": bool(
                        getattr(
                            user,
                            "id",
                            None,
                        )
                    ),
                },
            )

        except Exception:
            return HealthCheckResult(
                name=self.name,
                status=HealthStatus.UNHEALTHY,
                details={
                    "configured": True,
                    "reason": "telegram_api_unavailable",
                },
            )


__all__ = [
    "TelegramHealthCheck",
]

class ConversationEventRecord(Base):
    """

    Privacy design:

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from app.application.beta_access.models import (
    BetaConnectionToken,
    BetaUserState,
    TelegramBinding,
)


class InMemoryBetaUserRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._users: dict[str, BetaUserState] = {}

    async def save(self, user: BetaUserState) -> BetaUserState:
        self._users[user.user_id] = user
        return user

    async def get(
        self,
        user_id: str,
    ) -> Optional[BetaUserState]:
        return self._users.get(user_id)

    async def get_by_telegram_id(
        self,
        telegram_id: int,
    ) -> Optional[BetaUserState]:
        for user in self._users.values():
            if getattr(user, "telegram_id", None) == telegram_id:
                return user

        return None


class InMemoryBetaTokenRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._tokens: dict[str, BetaConnectionToken] = {}

    async def save(
        self,
        token: BetaConnectionToken,
    ) -> BetaConnectionToken:
        self._tokens[token.token_id] = token
        return token

    async def get(
        self,
        token_id: str,
    ) -> Optional[BetaConnectionToken]:
        return self._tokens.get(token_id)

    async def get_by_hash(
        self,
        token_hash: str,
    ) -> Optional[BetaConnectionToken]:
        for token in self._tokens.values():
            if token.token_hash == token_hash:
                return token

        return None

    async def mark_used(
        self,
        token: BetaConnectionToken,
    ) -> BetaConnectionToken:
        """
        Persist the token with its used_at timestamp.

        The application service passes an immutable replacement of
        the existing token, so the in-memory repository simply replaces
        the stored record.
        """
        self._tokens[token.token_id] = token
        return token

- Retrieve events by voice_call_id.
- Provide Beta persistence adapter.

Does NOT:

from __future__ import annotations



from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_event_repository import (
    VoiceCallEventRepository,
)



from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_event import (
    VoiceCallEvent,
)



class InMemoryVoiceCallEventRepository(
    VoiceCallEventRepository,
):
    """
    In-memory repository for Beta.

    Future replacement:
    PostgreSQL/event store implementation.
    """



    def __init__(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialise repository storage.
        """

        self._events: list[
            VoiceCallEvent
        ] = []



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        event: VoiceCallEvent,
    ) -> VoiceCallEvent:
        """
        Store a voice call event.
        """


        self._events.append(
            event
        )


        return event



    def get_by_voice_call_id(
        self,
        *,
        voice_call_id: str,
    ) -> list[VoiceCallEvent]:
        """
        Retrieve events for a voice call.
        """


        return [
            event
            for event in self._events
            if event.voice_call_id
            ==
            voice_call_id
        ]



    def get_all(
        self,
    ) -> list[VoiceCallEvent]:
        """
        Return all stored events.

        Useful for Beta diagnostics
        and tests.
        """


        return list(
            self._events
        )



__all__ = [
    "InMemoryVoiceCallEventRepository",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.application.conversation.conversation_event_models import (
    ConversationEvent,
)

from app.application.conversation.conversation_event_repository import (
    ConversationEventRepository,
)

from .conversation_event_records import (
    ConversationEventRecord,
)


class PostgreSQLConversationEventRepository(
    ConversationEventRepository
):
    """
    PostgreSQL implementation of conversation event storage.

    Privacy isolation:

        telegram_user_hash
                +
          conversation_id
                +
             world_id

    Governance:

        privacy_hash_version
                +
        retention_policy_id

    Responsibility:

    - persist conversation events
    - retrieve conversation history

    Does NOT:

    - validate business rules
    - create memories
    - analyse learning behaviour
    - create RAG knowledge
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        session_factory,
    ) -> None:
        if session_factory is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "session_factory cannot be None."
            )

        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def save(
        self,
        event: ConversationEvent,
    ) -> ConversationEvent:
        """
        Persist an anonymised conversation event.

        Privacy and retention governance values are taken
        from the validated event metadata and persisted into
        their dedicated database columns.
        """

        metadata = event.metadata or {}

        privacy_hash_version = metadata.get(
            "privacy_hash_version",
        )

        retention_policy_id = metadata.get(
            "retention_policy_id",
        )

        if not privacy_hash_version:
            raise ValueError(
                "Conversation event is missing "
                "privacy_hash_version."
            )

        if not retention_policy_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "Conversation event is missing "
                "retention_policy_id."
            )

        with self._session_factory() as session:
            record = ConversationEventRecord(
                id=event.event_id,
                conversation_id=event.conversation_id,
                telegram_user_hash=(
                    event.telegram_user_hash
                ),
                world_id=event.world_id,
                channel=event.channel,
                role=event.role,
                content=event.content,
                metadata_json=metadata,
                privacy_hash_version=(
                    privacy_hash_version
                ),
                retention_policy_id=(
                    retention_policy_id
                ),
                created_at=event.created_at,
            )

            session.add(record)
            session.commit()

        return event

    async def get_recent(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_hash: str,
        conversation_id: str,
        world_id: str,
        limit: int = 20,
    ) -> list[ConversationEvent]:
        """
        Retrieve recent conversation events for one
        pseudonymised Telegram identity, conversation,
        and learning world.

        Isolation key:

            telegram_user_hash
                    +
            conversation_id
                    +
                world_id

        Results are returned in chronological order so
        callers can construct conversation context safely.
        """

        if limit <= 0:
            return []

        if not telegram_user_hash:
            raise ValueError(
                "telegram_user_hash cannot be empty."
            )

        if not conversation_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "conversation_id cannot be empty."
            )

        if not world_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "world_id cannot be empty."
            )

        with self._session_factory() as session:
            rows = session.scalars(
                select(
                    ConversationEventRecord
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationEventRecord.telegram_user_hash
                    == telegram_user_hash
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationEventRecord.conversation_id
                    == conversation_id
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationEventRecord.world_id
                    == world_id
                )
                .order_by(
                    ConversationEventRecord.created_at.desc()
                )
                .limit(limit)
            ).all()

        return [
            _event_from_record(row)
            for row in reversed(rows)
        ]


def _event_from_record(
    row: ConversationEventRecord,
) -> ConversationEvent:
    """
    Convert the persistence record back into the
    application-domain conversation event.

    Governance fields remain available through metadata
    so the domain event retains its original contract.
    """

    metadata = dict(
        row.metadata_json or {}
    )

    metadata.setdefault(
        "privacy_hash_version",
        row.privacy_hash_version,
    )

    metadata.setdefault(
        "retention_policy_id",
        row.retention_policy_id,
    )

    return ConversationEvent(
        event_id=row.id,
        conversation_id=row.conversation_id,
        telegram_user_hash=(
            row.telegram_user_hash
        ),
        world_id=row.world_id,
        channel=row.channel,
        role=row.role,
        content=row.content,
        metadata=metadata,
        created_at=row.created_at,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.application.memory.memory_models import (
    ConversationMemory,
)

from app.application.memory.memory_repository import (
    ConversationMemoryRepository,
)

from .memory_records import (
    ConversationMemoryRecord,
)


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)



class PostgreSQLConversationMemoryRepository(
    ConversationMemoryRepository
):
    """
    PostgreSQL implementation of conversation memory storage.

    Isolation boundary:

        telegram_user_id
                +
             world_id

    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        session_factory,
    ) -> None:

        self._session_factory = session_factory



    async def save(
        self,
        memory: ConversationMemory,
    ) -> ConversationMemory:

        with self._session_factory() as session:

            row = session.get(
                ConversationMemoryRecord,
                memory.memory_id,
            )


            if row is None:

                session.add(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord(
                        id=memory.memory_id,

                        telegram_user_id=(
                            memory.telegram_user_id
                        ),

                        world_id=(
                            memory.world_id
                        ),

                        memory_key=(
                            memory.memory_key
                        ),

                        memory_value=(
                            memory.memory_value
                        ),

                        created_at=(
                            memory.created_at
                        ),
                    )
                )


            else:

                row.memory_value = (
                    memory.memory_value
                )


            session.commit()


        return memory



    async def get_user_memories(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_id: str,
        world_id: str,
    ) -> list[ConversationMemory]:

        with self._session_factory() as session:

            rows = session.scalars(
                select(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord.telegram_user_id
                    == telegram_user_id
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord.world_id
                    == world_id
                )
                .order_by(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord.created_at
                )
            ).all()


            return [
                _memory_from_record(row)
                for row in rows
            ]



    async def clear_user_memory(
        self,
        *,
        telegram_user_id: str,
        world_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        with self._session_factory() as session:

            rows = session.scalars(
                select(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord.telegram_user_id
                    == telegram_user_id
                )
                .where(
                    ConversationMemoryRecord.world_id
                    == world_id
                )
            ).all()


            for row in rows:
                session.delete(row)


            session.commit()



def _memory_from_record(
    row: ConversationMemoryRecord,
) -> ConversationMemory:

    return ConversationMemory(

        memory_id=row.id,

        telegram_user_id=(
            row.telegram_user_id
        ),

        world_id=(
            row.world_id
        ),

        memory_key=(
            row.memory_key
        ),

        memory_value=(
            row.memory_value
        ),

        created_at=(
            row.created_at
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class ExistingBotTelegramNotificationSender:
    """Outbound adapter around the existing Telegram Bot instance.

    No Bot is created here. The composition root injects the existing
    `TelegramBotRuntime.bot`.
    """

    def __init__(self, bot: Any) -> None:
        if bot is None:
            raise ValueError("bot cannot be None.")
        self._bot = bot

    async def send(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        portal_url: str,
    ) -> dict:
        if not chat_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("chat_id cannot be empty.")
        if not portal_url.strip():
            raise ValueError("portal_url cannot be empty.")

        from telegram import InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup

        markup = InlineKeyboardMarkup(
            [[InlineKeyboardButton("ðŸš€ Continue Learning", url=portal_url)]]
        )

        message = await self._bot.send_message(
            chat_id=chat_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
            reply_markup=markup,
        )

        return {
            "provider": "telegram",
            "status": "accepted",
            "message_id": getattr(message, "message_id", None),
        }

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

from telegram import Bot


class TelegramAnnouncementClient:
    """
    Outbound-only Telegram client for controlled announcements.

    This client is completely separate from TelegramBotRuntime.

    Responsibilities:
    - resolve TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
    - create an outbound Telegram Bot client lazily;
    - send controlled announcement messages;
    - release client resources.

    This client does NOT:
    - poll Telegram updates;
    - register handlers;
    - start polling;
    - execute classroom conversations;
    - perform administrator authorization;
    - bypass ControlledAnnouncementPublisher.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        token: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._token = (
            token
            or os.getenv("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN")
        )

        if not self._token:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is missing."
            )

        self._bot: Bot | None = None

    def _get_bot(self) -> Bot:
        """
        Return the outbound-only Telegram Bot client.

        The Bot is created lazily and never starts polling.
        """

        if self._bot is None:
            self._bot = Bot(
                token=self._token,
            )

        return self._bot

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        parse_mode: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """
        Send one outbound Telegram message.

        No Telegram polling is performed.
        """

        bot = self._get_bot()

        return await bot.send_message(
            chat_id=chat_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode=parse_mode,
        )

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """
        Release the outbound Telegram client.
        """

        if self._bot is None:
            return

        await self._bot.shutdown()

        self._bot = None


__all__ = [
    "TelegramAnnouncementClient",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class TelegramAnnouncementPublisher:
    """Thin infrastructure adapter for the Telegram announcement channel."""

    def __init__(self, *, telegram_client: Any) -> None:
        if telegram_client is None:
            raise ValueError("telegram_client cannot be None.")

        self._telegram_client = telegram_client

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        if not channel_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("channel_id is required.")

        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("text is required.")

        result = await self._telegram_client.send_message(
            chat_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
        )

        message_id = getattr(result, "message_id", None)
        if message_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Telegram publisher did not receive a message identifier."
            )

        return str(message_id)

    - bypass the controlled publication boundary.

    IMPORTANT RESPONSE OWNERSHIP:

        Telegram update
              |
              v
        TelegramBotRuntime
              |
              v
        BetaTelegramAdapter
              |
              +----> reply_text()
              |
              v
          response

    The adapter owns Telegram classroom response delivery.

    Therefore the runtime MUST NOT call reply_text() with the
    response returned by the adapter.

    This prevents duplicate Telegram messages.

    PUBLICATION CLIENT OWNERSHIP:

        TelegramBotRuntime
              |
              +----> existing Application
                           |
                           +----> existing Bot client
                                      |
                                      v
                         Controlled publication adapters

    The runtime remains the owner of Telegram client creation
    and lifecycle. Consumers receive a reference to the existing
    client through the read-only ``bot`` property.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        adapter: BetaTelegramAdapter,
        conversation_boundary: Any = None,
    ) -> None:
        if adapter is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "adapter cannot be None."
            )

        self._adapter = adapter

        # Retained for constructor compatibility with existing
        # composition. Runtime does not execute the boundary.
        self._conversation_boundary = conversation_boundary

        self._application: Application | None = None
        self._running = False

    # =========================================================
    # Application construction
    # =========================================================

    def build(self) -> Application:
        token = os.getenv(
            "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
        )

        if not token:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is missing."
            )

        application = (
            Application
            .builder()
            .token(token)
            .build()
        )

        application.add_handler(
            CommandHandler(
                "start",
                self._handle_start,
            )
        )

        application.add_handler(
            MessageHandler(
                filters.ChatType.PRIVATE
                & filters.TEXT
                & ~filters.COMMAND,
                self._handle_private_message,
            )
        )

        self._application = application

        logger.info(
            "Telegram bot runtime created."
        )

        return application

    # =========================================================
    # Existing Telegram bot client
    # =========================================================

    @property
    def bot(self) -> Any:
        """
        Return the existing Telegram bot client.

        The TelegramBotRuntime remains responsible for creating
        and owning the Telegram Application and its Bot client.

        This property does not create another client and does not
        expose credentials.

        Consumers may use this reference for controlled outbound
        operations such as the announcement publication adapter.

        Raises:
            RuntimeError: If the Telegram application has not yet
                been built.
        """

        if self._application is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Telegram bot runtime has not been built."
            )

        return self._application.bot

    # =========================================================
    # Lifecycle
    # =========================================================

    async def start(self) -> None:
        if self._running:
            logger.warning(
                "Telegram runtime already running."
            )
            return

        if self._application is None:
            self.build()

        assert self._application is not None

        await self._application.initialize()
        await self._application.start()

        if self._application.updater is not None:
            await self._application.updater.start_polling(
                drop_pending_updates=False,
            )

        self._running = True

        logger.info(
            "Telegram bot polling started."
        )

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._application is None:
            return

        if (
            self._application.updater is not None
            and self._running
        ):
            await self._application.updater.stop()

        await self._application.stop()
        await self._application.shutdown()

        self._running = False

        logger.info(
            "Telegram bot runtime stopped."
        )

    # =========================================================
    # Telegram handlers
    # =========================================================

    async def _handle_start(
        self,
        update: Update,
        context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE,
    ) -> None:
        await self._adapter.handle_start(
            update,
            context,
        )

    async def _handle_private_message(
        self,
        update: Update,
        context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE,
    ) -> None:
        if (
            update.effective_user is None
            or update.effective_chat is None
            or update.effective_message is None
        ):
            return

        try:
            # =================================================
            # SINGLE DELEGATION POINT
            # =================================================
            #
            # BetaTelegramAdapter:
            #
            #   1. validates transport
            #   2. authorizes access
            #   3. invokes conversation boundary
            #   4. sends Telegram response
            #   5. returns response for observation/testing
            #
            # The returned value MUST NOT be sent again.
            #

            await self._adapter.handle_message(
                update,
                context,
            )

        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "Unexpected Telegram adapter failure."
            )

            # This is ONLY an infrastructure-level fallback for
            # failures escaping the adapter itself.
            #
            # Normal conversation failures are already contained
            # by BetaTelegramAdapter.
            await update.effective_message.reply_text(
                "EasyChatBot is temporarily unavailable. "
                "Please try again."
            )


__all__ = [
    "TelegramBotRuntime",
]

class TelegramBotRuntime:

"""
LiveKit Conversation LLM Adapter.

Infrastructure adapter between LiveKit Agents
and EasyChatBot AI Runtime.

Responsibilities:
- Implement LiveKit LLM boundary.
- Translate LiveKit chat requests.
- Forward requests to ConversationRuntime.
- Convert runtime responses back to LiveKit format.

Does NOT:
- Call providers directly.
- Store conversations.
- Manage users.
- Manage LiveKit lifecycle.
- Own business logic.
"""

from __future__ import annotations


from dataclasses import dataclass


from livekit.agents import llm


from app.ai_runtime.conversation.conversation_runtime import (
    ConversationRuntime,
)



@dataclass(
    frozen=True,
    slots=True,
)
class LiveKitConversationLLM(
    llm.LLM,
):
    """
    Adapter exposing EasyChatBot ConversationRuntime
    as a LiveKit Agents LLM implementation.
    """


    conversation_runtime: ConversationRuntime

    character_instruction: str



    async def chat(
        self,
        *,
        chat_ctx: llm.ChatContext,
        tools: list[llm.Tool] | None = None,
        conn_options: llm.LLMOptions | None = None,
    ) -> llm.LLMStream:
        """
        Execute a conversation request.

        LiveKit sends the conversation context.
        EasyChatBot Runtime generates the response.

        The generated response is returned through
        a LiveKit compatible stream.
        """


        messages = []


        for item in chat_ctx.items:

            if hasattr(
                item,
                "role",
            ):

                messages.append(
                    {
                        "role": item.role,
                        "content": (
                            item.content
                            if isinstance(
                                item.content,
                                str,
                            )
                            else ""
                        ),
                    }
                )



        learner_message = ""


        for message in reversed(messages):

            if (
                message["role"]
                ==
                "user"
            ):

                learner_message = (
                    message["content"]
                )

                break



        response = await (
            self.conversation_runtime.respond(
                character_instruction=(
                    self.character_instruction
                ),
                learner_message=(
                    learner_message
                ),
            )
        )


        return (
            self._create_stream(
                response,
            )
        )



    def _create_stream(
        self,
        response: str,
    ) -> llm.LLMStream:
        """
        Convert EasyChatBot response into
        a LiveKit LLMStream.
        """


        stream = (
            llm.LLMStream(
                self,
                chat_ctx=llm.ChatContext(),
            )
        )


        stream._event_queue.put_nowait(
            llm.ChatChunk(
                delta=llm.ChoiceDelta(
                    content=response,
                )
            )
        )


        stream._event_queue.put_nowait(
            None
        )


        return stream



__all__ = [
    "LiveKitConversationLLM",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from app.application.beta_access.beta_telegram_conversation_boundary import (
    BetaTelegramConversationBoundary,
)
from app.interfaces.telegram.private_chat_gate import (
    BetaPrivateChatGate,
)


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class BetaTelegramAdapter:
    """
    Telegram transport adapter for the Beta private classroom.

    Responsibilities:
    - handle Telegram transport metadata;
    - enforce private-chat-only classroom access;
    - authorize Telegram identity through BetaPrivateChatGate;
    - forward authorized messages to BetaTelegramConversationBoundary;
    - deliver safe user-facing Telegram responses.

    Response ownership:

        Conversation Boundary
                |
                v
             response
                |
                v
        BetaTelegramAdapter
                |
                +----> Telegram reply_text()
                |
                v
             response

    IMPORTANT:

    The adapter is the SINGLE owner of classroom Telegram response
    delivery.

    The returned response is provided to the direct caller for
    testing, observability, and application-level inspection.

    The caller MUST NOT send the returned response to Telegram again.

    This adapter MUST NOT:
    - call an LLM/provider directly;
    - access persistence directly;
    - modify Beta user state directly;
    - bypass BetaAccessService;
    - process group/channel messages through the AI path.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        start_handler: Any,
        private_chat_gate: BetaPrivateChatGate,
        conversation_boundary: (
            BetaTelegramConversationBoundary | None
        ) = None,
    ) -> None:
        if start_handler is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "start_handler cannot be None."
            )

        if private_chat_gate is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "private_chat_gate cannot be None."
            )

        self._start_handler = start_handler
        self._private_chat_gate = private_chat_gate
        self._conversation_boundary = conversation_boundary

    # =========================================================
    # Telegram /start
    # =========================================================

    async def handle_start(
        self,
        update: Any,
        context: Any,
    ) -> None:
        user = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_user",
            None,
        )

        chat = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_chat",
            None,
        )

        message = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_message",
            None,
        )

        if user is None or chat is None:
            return

        telegram_user_id = getattr(
            user,
            "id",
            None,
        )

        chat_id = getattr(
            chat,
            "id",
            None,
        )

        chat_type = getattr(
            chat,
            "type",
            None,
        )

        if (
            telegram_user_id is None
            or chat_id is None
        ):
            return

        if chat_type != "private":
            await self._reply(
                message,
                (
                    "Please connect to the "
                    "EasyChatBot Academy from a "
                    "private Telegram chat."
                ),
            )
            return

        token = self._extract_start_token(
            context,
        )

        async def reply(
            text: str,
            user_override: Any = None,
        ) -> None:
            await self._reply(
                message,
                text,
            )

        await self._start_handler.handle(
            token=token,
            telegram_user_id=telegram_user_id,
            chat_id=chat_id,
            chat_type=chat_type,
            reply=reply,
        )

    # =========================================================
    # Private classroom message flow
    # =========================================================

    async def handle_message(
        self,
        update: Any,
        context: Any = None,
    ) -> str | None:
        """
        Process one Telegram classroom message.

        Response ownership is exclusively inside this adapter.

        Successful flow:

            transport validation
                    |
                    v
            private-chat authorization
                    |
                    v
            conversation boundary
                    |
                    v
              application response
                    |
                    +----> Telegram reply_text()
                    |
                    v
              return response

        The response is delivered exactly once.

        The caller may inspect the returned response but MUST NOT
        send it to Telegram again.
        """

        if self._conversation_boundary is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "conversation_boundary is not configured."
            )

        user = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_user",
            None,
        )

        chat = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_chat",
            None,
        )

        message = getattr(
            update,
            "effective_message",
            None,
        )

        if (
            user is None
            or chat is None
            or message is None
        ):
            return None

        telegram_user_id = getattr(
            user,
            "id",
            None,
        )

        chat_type = getattr(
            chat,
            "type",
            None,
        )

        if telegram_user_id is None:
            return None

        # =====================================================
        # HARD TRANSPORT BOUNDARY
        # =====================================================

        if chat_type != "private":
            return None

        # =====================================================
        # MESSAGE VALIDATION
        # =====================================================

        text = getattr(
            message,
            "text",
            None,
        )

        if not isinstance(
            text,
            str,
        ):
            return None

        text = text.strip()

        if not text:
            return None

        # =====================================================
        # BETA ACCESS AUTHORIZATION
        # =====================================================

        try:
            authorized = await (
                self._private_chat_gate.authorize(
                    telegram_user_id=telegram_user_id,
                    chat_type=chat_type,
                )
            )

        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "Telegram private-chat authorization failed."
            )

            await self._reply(
                message,
                (
                    "We could not verify your "
                    "EasyChatBot Academy access. "
                    "Please try again."
                ),
            )

            return None

        if not authorized:
            await self._reply(
                message,
                (
                    "Your EasyChatBot Academy Telegram "
                    "access is not authorized and is not "
                    "approved for Beta access."
                ),
            )

            return None

        # =====================================================
        # CONVERSATION BOUNDARY
        # =====================================================

        try:
            response = await (
                self._conversation_boundary.handle_message(
                    telegram_user_id=telegram_user_id,
                    message=text,
                )
            )

        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "Telegram classroom conversation processing failed."
            )

            await self._reply(
                message,
                (
                    "Sorry, I could not process "
                    "your classroom message. "
                    "Please try again."
                ),
            )

            return None

        # =====================================================
        # SINGLE RESPONSE DELIVERY POINT
        # =====================================================

        if (
            isinstance(response, str)
            and response.strip()
        ):
            await self._reply(
                message,
                response,
            )

            # Delivery has already happened exactly once.
            #
            # Return only for observability/testing.
            #
            # The runtime MUST ignore this value.
            return response

        return None

    # =========================================================
    # Helpers
    # =========================================================

    @staticmethod
    def _extract_start_token(
        context: Any,
    ) -> str | None:
        args = getattr(
            context,
            "args",
            None,
        )

        if not args:
            return None

        if not isinstance(
            args,
            (list, tuple),
        ):
            return None

        if not args[0]:
            return None

        return str(
            args[0]
        )

    @staticmethod
    async def _reply(
        message: Any,
        text: str,
    ) -> None:
        if message is None:
            return

        reply_text = getattr(
            message,
            "reply_text",
            None,
        )

        if reply_text is None:
            return

        await reply_text(
            text,
        )


__all__ = [
    "BetaTelegramAdapter",
]
